sources.title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B Model by NVIDIA | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-BF16 is the full-precision release of a general purpose reasoning and chat model, and is intended primarily for customization and post-training rather than direct production inference.

sources.title: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-4GB-BF16 | NVIDIA NeMo AutoModel
sources.snippet: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-4GB-BF16 is a small language model post-trained by NVIDIA from Gemma-4-E4B-it. It keeps the Gemma 4 E4B architecture and refreshes the weights and the chat template. The BF16 release is the full-precision checkpoint intended for customization, post-training, and evaluation.
